The free space is the only size limit: it stops the whole JOB, not one app

HS-06.note: a link is followed once and only into the owner home folder (podman unshare readlink, simulated here); never run against a real podman

HS-22.note: configtest then reads the converted folder from a throwaway volume (not run against a real podman: R7 confirms)

HS-15.note: ordinary extra tables, triggers and views are confirmed and removed in the SQLite child before API keys are replaced; a virtual table still stops Headscale because its module cannot be safely loaded or dropped

HS-02.note: no size limit: the job watchdog watches the free space and a backup that does not fit stops the whole JOB (a disk is shared; no app is imported); tested with a 5 GiB entry that only claims its size

HS-25.note: The SQLite child now supports replace_policies_from: HA policy replaces this device's; when HA has none, the live database policy is copied into the converted database. File policies and unusable policies keep their confirmation/stop rules. Unit evidence only.

HS-30.note: The conversion repeats the policy check and the real SQLite child copies the live database policy where HA has none. Unit evidence only.

OP-01.note: An add-on version the table does not know is a notice, older or newer alike (nothing tells them apart: HA newer than this device is OP-03, wave 2, where HA core is installed or this device updated); both revisions known and different stays a stop.

OP-05.note: The download is hatarget.ensure_image (F3) through hacommon.image_labels; the package builds its image on the device (localhost/...), which cannot be downloaded: a stop of this app only that says so. A Quadlet without Image= stays a stop.

OP-11.note: Default-deny: the content of a file that stays in HA is copied only when it moves anyway or is a package manager cache; a login, the Paseo pairing, the Omnigent identity, the rewritten preferences and HA MCP token are never copied, the link is left out and listed (files.skipped).

OP-15.note: The pause is an auto line (it touches only the app itself, which the restore stops anyway); DESIGN E1 says "listed in the confirmation": the level is one word in ISSUES.

OP-16.note: A kept link whose file is not in the export at all cannot be known in the check: it is the "ask once more" case (DESIGN B7).

CS-04.note: Volumes and host folders of this device's entry are carried (hatarget.carry); a DATABASE in the entry is not (no package has one): a stop of this app only. No container or one of the three volumes missing stays a stop.

CS-10.note: Default-deny as OP-11: logins, accounts, this device's own files, programs and the connectors' identity are never copied.

CS-13.note: Most of it is READ's reader (a link to a file outside projects/ comes as a file); the walk's own fallback is covered by a stub of the folder writer.

CS-14.note: Auto line, not a confirm (see OP-15).

OP-13.note: The limit is 16 MiB (was 4); above it the file is read_or_skip (READ) and listed, this device's own file stays.

CS-11.note: Limits 16 MiB (was 4) and 64 MiB for the prompt history (was 32); above them read_or_skip lists the file.

CS-12.note: Healthy databases the reader could not check are left behind with ONE confirmed line (B1: something does not move); damaged ones stay a reminder as before.

CS-17.note: Only known in the conversion (DESIGN B7): the result and the import note say it (extensions_unreadable, a reminder to install them again), no line of the check.

E-23.note: EMQX_LOG_DIR of the Quadlet (or of its EnvironmentFile=) is this device's folder; the candidate has the same environment and its own log volume there as scratch (unit level: that a real broker boots with it is for R4)

E-24.note: target_etc_dir answers whatever plain folder the broker reports; ${EMQX_ETC_DIR} is resolved there; the candidate must report the same

E-29.note: any normalised name of the data volume is carried (snapshot_name_ok); the archive protections (link, double, size, unsafe name) still stop only this app

E-30.note: relative data/... paths (the Dashboard's form), mounts, secrets and the image's own files are resolved by resolve_path; one that cannot be placed is named, never a stop

E-32.note: no list of roots any more; the scan covers every root (depth over 32 still stops only this app; 1200 odd random configurations never crash it)

E-35.note: log files and the crash dump outside /opt/emqx/log get the candidate's log volume as scratch; a place inside /opt/emqx or below a mount of this device stops only this app

E-36.note: only node.data_dir that is not this image's stops; applications, config_files, shard_transports, etc_dir and unlisted fields pass

E-41.note: names of this device's rules, connectors, actions, sources, bridges and gateways, asked only when HA's import brought entries of the kind (nothing mixed = nothing to ask); same name = HA's wins (the import is a merge); the number replaced is in the message, never in the key

E-42.note: topic rewrite, topic metrics, auto-subscribe and ExHook servers of this device, asked only when HA brought entries of the kind; S1 may name the same ExHook servers (it reads the finished candidate, conservative)

E-43.note: PSK authentication or a PSK file of this device: HA's keys replace this device's

E-50.note: setting names only in the notice; a file of the image or a mount is the candidate's; one in the data volume is carried

E-33.note: alarm, slow_subs, trace, crl_cache, telemetry, delayed, overload_protection: nothing is refused

E-34.note: unlisted fields of node, rpc, cluster, log, banned, api_key stop nothing

E-37.note: rpc: any protocol, ssl without all its files

E-39.note: log: a file section of any shape, an enabled handler without a path

E-40.note: banned and api_key bootstrap_file that is no text

E-45.note: Prometheus export or push: nothing is refused (the candidate has no network)

E-46.note: the system monitor's external database: nothing is refused

E-44.note: reminder done; the plugin records are NOT cleared (DESIGN says clear): the vendor only logs a plugin that is not installed (emqx_plugins.erl:310-323, 766-781), clearing would change this device's own settings

E-47.note: a confirm line (DESIGN B12): the messages queued for offline devices are lost when the data volume is replaced
